title: RunManifest
description: How one generation run produced its output (Constitution Principles II and III). Validatable per FR-028; validation names any missing element. The reconciliation rule records_generated - sum(discards) == records_written is enforced by the model, not expressible here.

schema_version.description: The record contract version this run wrote against (FR-025).

seed.description: The explicit run seed (FR-025, Principle II).

dirty.description: True when the working tree had uncommitted changes. A SHA recorded from a dirty tree would misrepresent what produced the artifact (research R10).

input_hashes.description: Path -> sha256 for every run input: prompt document (FR-008a), rubric (FR-009g), config file.

models.description: Both roles recorded: the judge shapes which records survive and is therefore a non-deterministic input (FR-009j, FR-027).

fallbacks_used.description: Model ID -> records it served after a refusal fallback. Empty when none occurred.

records_generated.description: Every response received from the generating model, counted once per attempt; a slot retried three times contributes three (FR-026a). The shared denominator for every discard-rate threshold, so a threshold cannot be computed two ways.

discards.description: Every discarded record by count and reason. Silent dropping is prohibited (Principle III, FR-026).

retry_counts.description: Transport retries by class. Deliberately separate from discards: a degraded provider and a defective generator are different facts (FR-012d).

resumed_count.description: How many times this run was resumed; an interruption is a material fact about how the corpus was produced (FR-015d).

duplicate_count.description: Exact duplicate conversations produced; reported, never discarded (FR-034, research R13).

coherence_score_distribution.description: Bucket label -> record count, so corpus quality is visible rather than assumed (SC-009).

output_sha256.description: Checksum of the artifact this manifest describes.

sampling_seed.description: Null states plainly that no sampling seed was used, rather than implying reproducibility the run cannot deliver (FR-010).

reason.description: Closed set: an open-ended reason string would make FR-026's reconciliation unauditable.

Distribution.description: Enum member -> proportion. Sums to 1.0 within epsilon; only members of the corresponding enum are permitted (FR-030, FR-032).
